questions.q: What does the server audit object (CREATE SERVER AUDIT) actually define?
options: The destination the audit writes to — a file, the Windows Security log, or the Application log
Which specific tables get audited
The login policy for the instance
The database's recovery model
questions.explain: CREATE SERVER AUDIT defines the top-level object and its output destination; what gets captured is defined separately by audit specifications.

questions.q: Which object would you use to capture every SELECT against one specific table, by anyone?
options: A database audit specification with ADD (SELECT ON dbo.Payroll BY public)
A server audit specification with FAILED_LOGIN_GROUP
A fixed database role
A DENY statement
questions.explain: Database audit specifications provide object-level granularity, including capturing a specific statement type against a specific table.

questions.q: What does ON_FAILURE = SHUTDOWN do on a server audit, and why is it used rarely?
options: It halts SQL Server itself if the audit target becomes unreachable, which is a serious operational risk in most environments
It shuts down only the audit feature, leaving the instance running
It automatically restarts the audit after a failure
It has no real effect and exists only for backward compatibility
questions.explain: SHUTDOWN prioritizes never letting an action go unaudited over instance availability — appropriate only for the strictest compliance requirements, since an unreachable log location would take production down.

questions.q: Which function reads recorded events back out of a file-based SQL Server Audit target?
options: sys.fn_get_audit_file
sys.dm_exec_sessions
sys.server_principals
sys.fn_get_audit_events
questions.explain: sys.fn_get_audit_file is the table-valued function for querying audit records out of .sqlaudit files.

questions.q: What is a server audit specification used for, as distinct from a database audit specification?
options: Capturing instance-wide event groups like failed logins or server role membership changes
Capturing SELECT statements against one specific table
Defining the audit's file destination
Encrypting audit output with TDE
questions.explain: Server audit specifications attach pre-built, server-scoped action groups (failed logins, role changes, etc.); database audit specifications handle database/object-level events.
